mapper.select: SELECT dul.id, ucg.id source_id, ucg.pkg_config_group_id, pcg.pkg, pcg.pvc, pcg.svc, ucg.user_id, pcg.name, ucg.config_group_type, ucg.config_group_id from ods_user_config_group_diversion ucg left join ods_pkg_config_group_diversion pcg on (ucg.pkg_config_group_id = pcg.id) LEFT JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.source_id = ucg.id) where ucg.id = #{userLabId}
